title: GRAIUL county tiles
description: The 42 tiles (41 counties and the municipality of Bucharest) of the schematic map in the app: ISO 3166-2:RO code, name and a column/row position that keeps neighbours roughly where they are. It is a diagram, not a geographic map. scripts/validate.py also checks that the codes are the ones schema.json accepts for `county` and that no two tiles share a cell.
